notes.title: Final Playtesting Update -- Thanks so much for the feedback!!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to all the play testers who have provided me with incredible feedback so far. You helped shape this video game.

This will be the last update I publish for the playtest. There's still plenty to balance and many bugs to fix, but you'll have to wait for the full release to see those changes applied!

Here's some of what changed:
[list]
[*] Keyword acquisition has new minigames
[*] New mystery rooms
[*] Secret bonus level (can you unlock it?)
[*] New bosses
[*] Reworked many enemies
[*] New keywords
[*] New viruses
[*] LeetMode -- unlock modifiers that make the game easier or harder
[*] New music, sound effects
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[*] Performance improvements
[*] 'champion' enemies
[*] Upgrade keywords to increase their power
[*] Balance tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Playtesting Update: Balance Tweaks & Quality of LIfe
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You can now change windows with the arrow keys!
[*] Adjusted bosses' stats.
[*] Edited almost every regular encounter.
[*] Rebalanced some behind-the-scenes scalars.
[*] Added an ERROR window.
[*] Added RAM and Crypto drops after normal encounters.
[*] Reworked the way viruses recharge,
[*] Added icons to the NodeNet.
[*] Changed the level generation logic to make special event rooms more special.
[*] Changed the RESTORE sound effect.
[*] MultiCore and SIGTERM now synergize.
[*] memLeak triggers less often.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Exit Node to spawn in an awkward position.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused MultiCore to appear as if it were targeting things it wasn't.
[/list]

notes.title: Platesting Update: Shop & Viruses
notes.notes:
Added some new stuff to the game
[list]
[*] Spend your crypto with "The D34L3R" on Keywords & HP 
[*] Chance to gain special Keywords RESTORE, SIGTERM, downloadRAM
[*] Added viruses: KEYLOGGGER, HYPERCLOCK, unsafeGet, & more!
[*] Changed the Keyword encounter -- play ASCII-Snake to hack new Keywords!
[*] Fixed a bug with the VPN
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bounds-checking bug that froze the minimap after completing a level.

notes.title: Responding to Your Feedback: Bug fixes and UI tweaks
notes.notes:
Not too much in the way of new content for this patch, but your feedback has been incredibly helpful in shaping my plans for the game. Here's what changed in this small patch:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused errors while loading old saves
[*] Reworked the way keywords recharge
[*] Fixed some navigation bugs on the Node map
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Terminal to lose focus
[*] Reworked the way Keywords are displayed on screen.
[/list]

And some changes that you won't see, but will pave the way for some new content down the line:
[list]
[*] Refactored the hostile hacker code to allow for more diverse encounters
[*] Added support for new types of keywords
[/list]
